name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Classic Double Cheeseburger (Plain / Mild Mod)
whyItWorks: Ordering Dan's double cheeseburger plain or with simple ketchup/mustard eliminates crunchy raw onions and acid pickles, making it a very digestible high-protein roadside comfort meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Double Cheeseburger plain or with ketchup and yellow mustard only (no onions, pickles, or lettuce).
watchOuts: Griddled double chuck patties carry grease; stick to a single patty during active symptoms
